newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Black group clinches Johnnic deal - paper.
newsitem.headline: Black group clinches Johnnic deal - paper.

text.p: The long-awaited deal for the National Empowerment Consortium (NEC) to buy Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd's 48 percent stake in Johnnies Industrial Corp Ltd has been finalised, Business Day newspaper reported on Wednesday.
Details of the deal could be unveiled later on Wednesday, the paper said, quoting negotiating sources.
Neither side would confirm agreement had been reached.
Johnnic -- whose assets include stakes in South African Breweries, Toyota South Africa , Premier Group and Times Media -- is due to announce its year-end results on Wednesday.
At Tuesday's share price, Anglo and associate De Beers' combined 48 percent stake in Johnnic was worth 4.24 billion rand.
The deal will be by far the largest black empowerment venture to date.
